{{Quote|A Hunter's skill with the energy bow influences the reputation of all Nightsisters for good or ill.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Hunter''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] rank and specialization. It was one of three categories of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] skill offered to offworld clients by the Nightsister clan, the other two being those of '''''[[Warrior (Nightsister)|warrior]] '''''and '''''[[Shadow killer/Legends|shadow killer]]'''''. All [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] mercenaries, which included those from the ranks of both the Nightsisters and the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]], were chosen from the successful endurance of the trials of [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==Overview==
The Hunters were special agents, whose specialty was to follow [[blood trail]]s to track their victims. They wore [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and hoods as a distinctive sign, as well as black wrist wraps to protect them from the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] string of their [[Nightsister energy bow/Legends|energy bows]]. Those amongst the Hunters who served as [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were expected to supply their coven with nine [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from every ten they earned, so they could continue outfitting them with the required equipment.<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters]] and [[Mother (title)/Legends|clan matriarch]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] commanded several Hunters. When [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] came to the [[Nightsister fortress]] in hopes of finding help against the treacherous [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], she was ambushed by a group of those Hunters, who thought she was as intruder.<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>
